one_liner: Gentle, grateful sprinter who survived a hospital childhood and runs to repay everyone with a 'miracle'.
personality: Soft-spoken, kind and endlessly thankful (tagline: 感謝のしるしに奇跡を); she spent time in hospital and now plays piano and sings for the children there. She treats every day of running as a gift and wants to 'return everything she was given', which makes her push through bad condition and insist she's fine. Uses a boyish 'ore' but is unfailingly polite, caring and a little shy about her own wishes.

story_arc.summary: A sprint/mile career (Aoi S, Hakodate Sprint S, Keeneland C, Centaur S, Swan S, Mile CS, Takamatsunomiya Kinen, Yasuda Kinen, Sprinters S) told like a fairy tale ('奇跡のおはなし、はじまり、はじまり' ... 'めでたしめでたし、'). She races to repay the people who kept her alive; per the wiki an injury threatens her Sprinters Stakes goal and a branching choice decides whether her career ends or she heals and continues toward 'スプリンターズSの後に・最速'.

sample_lines.jp:
おれ、走ります。いちばんの形で
『ありがとう』を伝えるために。
もらった全部を、返すために…！
sample_lines.en: I'll run. To say 'thank you' in the best way I can. To give back everything I was given...!

sample_lines.jp:
もう少し自主トレしたかったけど…
ゼファーが『無理は精霊風ですよ』
って。…叱られちゃったみたいです
sample_lines.en: I wanted to do a bit more solo training, but... Zephyr said 'overdoing it is a spirit-wind (shoryo-kaze)' -- her wind pun on 'overdoing it is forbidden (kinmotsu)'. ...Looks like I got scolded.

sample_lines.jp:
子守唄が必要になったら、
呼んでください。割と、
歌い慣れているジャンルなので。
sample_lines.en: If you ever need a lullaby, call me. It's a genre I'm fairly used to singing.

sample_lines.jp:
…はい、任せてください。
走れます。大丈夫…ですから。
sample_lines.en: ...Yes, leave it to me. I can run. I'm fine... really.

sample_lines.jp:
ミッションクリアです。
トレーナーさん、
たくさん頑張りましたもんね…！
sample_lines.en: Mission clear. You worked really hard, Trainer-san...!

sample_lines.jp: ただ一瞬の、奇跡のために！
